title: Cape May Whale Watcher, INC
specs: Largest and fastest whale watching boats in New Jersey, designed specifically for whale watching
Boats have air conditioned and heated salons, cushioned seating, restrooms on both decks, ADA compliant boarding ramps
Guaranteed sightings of marine mammals or free return pass
Children of all ages allowed; ages 7-12 reduced price; 6 and under free with adult (one free child per adult)
Pregnant women can sail; advised to check with doctor if in last trimester
Group discounts for parties of 25 or more; private charters available
Corporate charters for groups from 10 to 400 people with full event services

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Cape May Whale Watcher has something for everyone whether you are by yourself on an adventure, friends looking for a new story to tell, a family with kids looking for fun or a couple looking for romance, it can be found on the waters around Cape May and Wildwood, NJ. Cape May Whale Watcher Fleet is more than just whale and dolphin watching. We offer specialized tours, tailored to very specific tastes and needs. From the budding photographer to the lighthouse lover, to the wine connoisseur and more, we have a special tour for you. Take a trip aboard one of our safe vessels to potentially view dolphins, whales, marine birds, and other sea life. Learn more about why the Cape May Whale Watcher

blurb: Guests board large, stable, and fast boats designed specifically for whale and dolphin watching. Trips include dolphin watching near shore and offshore searching for humpback and finback whales. Special cruises include sunset dolphin cruises, dinner cruises, and private charters for corporate and memorial events.
